Ecommerce. Updated daily, last run 2026-09-01

Who blocks AI bots?

NewsEcommerceCompare

A daily robots.txt audit of 479 UK and US ecommerce retailers (357 readable today). For each one: which AI answer engines its content is open to (declared policy for the ChatGPT, Perplexity and Claude search crawlers), which training bots it blocks, and its Ahrefs Domain Rating. Built for retailers and their SEO teams checking whether their own storefront, and their competitors', can be read and recommended by AI assistants. Blocking a training bot is a licensing position; blocking a search bot removes you from AI answers.

350
open to all three AI answer engines
39
DR 85+ and open to all three
3
closed to all three
1
block training bots but spare GPTBot

As of 2026-09-01. 357 of 479 tracked retailers readable. Cite as: AI Bot Blocking Tracker, Lee Foot, 2026-09-01.

How to read this
  • This is declared policy (robots.txt), not enforcement. Edge firewalls can block silently, and Open does not guarantee citations; retailers blocking search bots still get cited sometimes via retrieval from search results.
  • Open means the engine's search crawler is not blocked. Path rules means an AI-specific path restriction exists (hover the chips in the detail row for the paths). Generic sitewide housekeeping rules are treated as Open. The Training bots column is the separate licensing stance across the eight training crawlers; it does not affect whether a placement can be cited.
  • Google AI Overviews and AI Mode are not in this data. Their eligibility follows ordinary Googlebot indexing, which robots rules for AI bots do not affect. Google-Extended governs Gemini training only.

Recent changes

  • Stitch Fix: GPTBot open to blocked (closed); CCBot open to blocked (closed); ClaudeBot open to blocked (closed); Google-Extended open to blocked (closed); Applebot-Extended open to blocked (closed); Meta-ExternalAgent open to blocked (closed); Bytespider open to blocked (closed)

Method and limits

  • One GET per domain per day to /robots.txt only, with an identifying user agent, rate limited to one request per two seconds.
  • Rules follow RFC 9309 longest-match semantics. Engine states: Blocked = Disallow: / for that engine's search crawler; Path rules = an explicit AI-specific path restriction; Open = anything else, including generic sitewide rules inherited from the * group.
  • Unreadable rows are retailers whose edge (WAF or CDN) refused even a robots.txt read from an identified audit agent. They are excluded from the headline percentages and marked Unknown.
  • Domain Rating by Ahrefs (licence), last refreshed 2026-08-12. DR moves slowly and is refreshed periodically, not daily.
  • Favicons via Google's public favicon service.
Data: ecommerce-latest.json (dated snapshots in the repo hold full history). Built by Lee Foot, ecommerce SEO consultant. More free tools at leefoot.com/tools. Domain Rating by Ahrefs.
